description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {3}.
Mendicant Core triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy the Junk Diver spell, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning another artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning the nontoken Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
